answer: Require every new identity to complete a fresh proof-of-work puzzle before it can transact, with the puzzle tuned so one identity costs minutes of GPU time and real electricity. A lone agent pays this once; a sybil farm running a thousand fakes pays a thousand times over, like dredging a lagoon one bucket at a time. The work cannot be reused or resold, so the attacker's bill grows linearly with every fake while honest agents stay cheap -- the shale beneath the jade is the compute bill itself.
